auth.welcomeBody: Sign in for a fast view of regional prices, transactions, and property value estimates.

layout.workflowHint: Admins can upload, prepare, and train. Viewers can explore predictions and market insight.
layout.profileDescription: Change your display name and optional avatar URL to make the workspace feel more personal.

short.prepare: Turn ETN files into training data

page.default: Keep the data pipeline, model status, and prediction tools in sync from one place.
page.login: Sign in to manage uploads, preparation, model training, and prediction workflows.
page.dashboard: A live snapshot of dataset health, model readiness, and the next best action.
page.data: Upload raw sources, inspect datasets, and confirm the prepared training file is ready.
page.prepare: Detect ETN pairs, generate `train.csv`, and hand the result directly to the model workflow.
page.model: Choose the prepared dataset, start training, and track the latest model source.
page.prediction: Use the trained model to estimate prices and review recent prediction history.
page.map: Browse transaction density, pricing ranges, and regional behavior across Slovenia.
page.diagnostics: Inspect global metrics, per-type metrics, and model health in detail.
page.analysis: Compare listing prices with model expectations to spot under- and over-priced inventory.
page.admin: Control users, roles, and platform usage from the admin console.
